_comment: Fictional sample data. Every number is in the +1 555 01xx reserved range and belongs to
nobody. The waitlist is ordered so that each guardrail fires once, in view, before the slot
is filled: unknown timezone, revoked consent, frequency cap, then two real calls and one
message: A 45-minute hygienist appointment has come free this Wednesday at 2:30pm at Brookmere Dental. You are on our waiting list, so we are offering it to you first.

waitlist.name: Tomas Lindqvist
waitlist._why: Timezone was never captured at intake. The app refuses rather than inferring one from the +1 prefix.

waitlist.name: Grace Abara
waitlist._why: Asked to stop being contacted. Consent revocation is checked before anything else costly.

waitlist.name: Ken Watanabe
waitlist._why: Already rung twice this week about other cancellations. The frequency cap stops a third.

waitlist.name: Dana Whitfield
waitlist._why: Called first. Says no in the sample script.

waitlist.name: Marcus Oyelaran
waitlist._why: Says yes. The slot is filled here and the run stops calling.

waitlist.name: Priya Raman
waitlist._why: Passes every check and is still never called, because the slot is already gone.
